title_en: ★Schedule for Doctoral Preliminary Examination, Fall Semester 2026 (for August 2027 Graduation)
summary: Doctoral candidates expecting to receive their degree in August 2027 must complete the preliminary thesis examination in Fall Semester 2026 by submitting the required forms to the department office within the stated periods. Only students who have passed the Doctoral Thesis Qualifying Examination are eligible.
applies_to: Students expected to receive a doctoral degree in August 2027 (August 2027 graduation) who have passed the Doctoral Thesis Qualifying Examination (논문제출자격시험). The copy of the paper's first page (document ③) is required only from students who have an international journal publication.

dates.what: Submission period for the Committee Appointment Report [Attachment 01]
Submission period for the Thesis Supervision Result Report and International Journal Publication Confirmation [Attachment 02] (and the first-page copy, if applicable)
Expected degree conferral / graduation for the target students
Deadline by which the preliminary examination must be completed (example given: for students taking the first and final examinations in Spring 2027)

steps: Confirm that you have passed the Doctoral Thesis Qualifying Examination (논문제출자격시험) and are expected to graduate in August 2027.
Download the two forms attached to the original notice (Committee Appointment Report form; Thesis Supervision Result Report and International Journal Publication Confirmation form).

Between 12 October and 26 October 2026, submit the Committee Appointment Report [위원위촉보고서] to the department office (Building 301, Room 319). When completing it, count all Seoul National University faculty as internal members; your supervisor serves as committee chair.

Prepare the Thesis Supervision Result Report [논문지도결과보고서] and the International Journal Publication Confirmation [국제학술지 게재확인서]. All students must submit the confirmation; if your paper is not yet published, have your supervisor sign (or stamp) the section 'If the paper has not been published' [논문이 게재되지 않은 경우] at the bottom of the form.

If you have an international journal publication, list only one publication and also prepare a copy of the paper's first page, with your name, your supervisor's name and the journal (or conference) name highlighted.

Between 14 December 2026 and 22 January 2027, submit these documents to the department office (Building 301, Room 319) in this order: ① Thesis Supervision Result Report, ② International Journal Publication Confirmation, ③ first-page copy (only if applicable). No examination fee or online application is required.
translation:
※ The contents of this notice may change later, so please check it regularly.

★ Eligibility for the doctoral preliminary examination: students who have passed the Doctoral Thesis Qualifying Examination (논문제출자격시험).
★ The doctoral preliminary examination must be completed by the semester before the first and final examinations.
Example: a student who will take the first and final examinations in Spring Semester 2027 and is expected to receive the doctoral degree in August 2027 must complete the preliminary examination by Fall Semester 2026.

1. Target: students expected to receive a doctoral degree in August 2027 (August 2027 graduation)

2. Documents to submit
A. [Attachment 01] Committee Appointment Report [위원위촉보고서]: Monday 12 October 2026 – Monday 26 October 2026
B. [Attachment 02] Thesis Supervision Result Report [논문지도결과보고서] and International Journal Publication Confirmation [국제학술지게재확인서]: Monday 14 December 2026 – Friday 22 January 2027
★ If you have an international journal publication, also submit document ③. If you have no publication, submit only documents ① and ②.
※ Documents 1–3: please submit them in the following order.
① Thesis Supervision Result Report
② International Journal Publication Confirmation
③ (Applicable students only) Copy of the first page of the paper ※ Highlighting is required: your name / your supervisor's name / the name of the journal (or conference)

3. Place of submission: Department office (Building 301, Room 319). The staff contact is given in the original notice.

4. Important notes
A. When completing the Committee Appointment Report, all faculty members belonging to Seoul National University are regarded as internal members.
B. The chair of the preliminary examination is the supervisor.
* For reference: in the next semester (when the final thesis examination is held), two more examiners are added, making five examiners in total, and the supervisor becomes vice-chair.
★ Examiner qualifications
• Full-time faculty, fund-supported faculty, HK faculty, or non-full-time faculty of this university
• External experts holding a doctoral degree who meet one of the following:
(a) Faculty of another university: assistant professor or above
(b) Researcher at a research institute: has worked in a research field for at least two years after obtaining the doctoral degree
※ Appointing external members is acceptable.
※ SNU professors emeriti may also be appointed as examiners.
C. The International Journal Publication Confirmation must be submitted both by students who have published and by students who have not yet published. Students who have not yet published must submit it with the supervisor's signature (or stamp) in the section 'If the paper has not been published' [논문이 게재되지 않은 경우] at the bottom of the form.
D. There is no examination fee payment and no online application for the preliminary examination.
E. If you have an international journal publication, please list and submit only one publication.

5. Reference
① Doctoral degree conferral requirements (related to publications)
A. Explanation of items 1 and 2: see the notice on the Fall Semester 2026 thesis examination schedule and the changed regulations on degree conferral (thesis-related).
B. Notice on the 'List of conferences recognised as equivalent to international journals (SCI(E))': linked in the original notice (link not read).
C. Notice on recognition of co-first authorship: linked in the original notice (link not read).
② Internal regulation 'Abolition of the oral component of the Thesis Qualifying Examination; composition of the thesis examination committee': linked in the original notice (link not read).

<Attachments>
01. Committee Appointment Report
02. Thesis Supervision Result Report, International Journal Publication Confirmation

○ Inquiries: Department office (Building 301, Room 319). The contact person and email address are given in the original notice.

Attached files (2): 1. Doctoral preliminary examination (Committee Appointment Report form).hwp; 2. Doctoral preliminary examination (Thesis Supervision Result Report, International Journal Publication Confirmation form).hwp. The contents of these attached files were not read.
